craft_notes: Sthāyin: Courage of refuge (utsāha). Dash→colon after it (staging done, bliss released). Rejected: 'lace' for 'stage' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: To thee who stage the churned dim and crack it: bliss
of gnosis, twinless — God, who hoods and unhoods: hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate

reads_against.argmap: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks. → Bow to breaker and uncoverer of delusion, knowledge-bliss nondual.
c1_essence: Breaker and uncoverer of churned stupor: gnosis-bliss without pairs.

l2.plain_english: To you I bow — you conjure the churned stupor of becoming, then shatter it: bliss of gnosis, no pairs — O god, veiler and unveiler.
l2.sanskrit_cite: namas te bhavasambhrāntabhrāntim udbhāvya bhindate jñānānandaṃ ca nirdvandvaṃ deva vṛtvā vivṛṇvate

l3: To thee who stage the churned dim and crack it — bliss

reads_against.t1: Bow to you who, having manifested the becoming-agitated delusion, breaks it — to knowledge-bliss, nondual — O god, having covered, to uncoverer.
